# Nullshift

> Nullshift (legal name: Nullshift Development Ltd) is a UK development
> company that designs, builds and runs bespoke business systems —
> agentic AI automations, booking and payments platforms, client portals
> and the operations behind them. Clients own everything outright: the
> code, the data and the accounts. No per-seat SaaS fees.

## Canonical facts

- Legal name: Nullshift Development Ltd
- Trading name: Nullshift
- Companies House number: 17284213
- UK ICO data protection registration: ZC214743 (register entry:
  https://ico.org.uk/ESDWebPages/Entry/ZC214743)
- Registered office: 66 Paul Street, London, England, EC2A 4NA
- Co-Founders: Louis McKenzie (Co-Founder & Lead Developer,
  https://www.linkedin.com/in/louis-mckenzie-a287b9247) and

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nullshift-development-ltd
- Contact: louis@nullshift.co.uk
- Website: https://nullshift.co.uk
- Area served: United Kingdom (based), worldwide (remote)

Disambiguation: this Nullshift is the UK software development company at
nullshift.co.uk. It is unrelated to musical artists or gaming projects
that share the name.

## What Nullshift does

- Bespoke system builds: custom booking systems, payments platforms
  (Stripe / GoCardless), client portals, admin tools, automated email
  flows — built to be owned outright by the client.
- Agentic AI automation: end-to-end AI workflows that carry out real
  operational tasks, not just chat.
- Ongoing plans (monthly, cancel any time). Prices are "from" figures: the
  plan sets the service level, and the monthly rate then scales with the
  platform's usage, complexity, organisation size and commercial importance.
  - Core — from £40/month: managed hosting, domain, database and SSL,
    monitoring, backups, platform upkeep and bug fixes to agreed
    functionality. Response target 2 UK business days. For simple,
    low-change systems.
  - Pro — from £80/month: everything in Core, plus managed AI-agent/API
    capability, transactional email infrastructure, enhanced monitoring of
    APIs, email delivery and integrations, and configuration support.
    Response target 1 UK business day. For operational systems.
  - Max — from £120/month: everything in Pro, plus a named technical owner,
    quarterly roadmap review, monthly platform health review, free feature
    discovery and scoping, and priority scheduling. Response target 4 UK
    business hours. For businesses wanting an ongoing technical partner.
  - Enterprise — price on application: contracted uptime and response SLAs,
    security and procurement support, dedicated environments, custom service
    cadence and optional reserved development capacity.
- No plan includes feature development. Recurring fees cover the platform,
  service level and technical partnership; new capabilities are always
  separately quoted fixed-price projects with a written scope, acceptance
  criteria and a fixed price agreed before work starts.
- Support versus development: if a request changes what the product can do,
  it is development. If it keeps an existing capability working, or
  configures that capability within its original design, it is support and is
  included in the plan.
- The one-off build is quoted to scope, not sold from a price list.
- Security & compliance: UK/EU hosting, encryption in transit and at
  rest, audit trails, and a signed Data Processing Agreement before any
  system goes live. Nullshift is ICO-registered (ZC214743).

## How engagement works

1. A free tailored plan: describe the pain points, Nullshift proposes
   what to automate and what it saves.
2. A fixed-price proposal signed in the client portal (with a DPA for
   limited companies).
3. The build, with progress visible in the client portal.
4. Optional monthly plan (Core, Pro, Max or Enterprise) covering the
   platform, service level and technical partnership — collected by
   Direct Debit, cancel any time. Feature work stays separately quoted.
